description.text: Application Deadline: August 31: applications for Master s Degree Programs for the next spring semester enrollment March 31: applications for Master s Degree Programs for the fall semester enrollment

duration.text: The Oil-gas Field Development Engineering at Yanshan University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2750 USD/per year ￥ 19800 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) The copy of HSK level certificate (Level-6 is required by Liberal Arts majors and Level-4 is required by Sciences majors). 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents
